dish_name_kh: សម្លប្រហើរ

ingredients.raw_kh: ឬត្រីសណ្ដាយ
ស្លឹកម្ទេស
ត្រឡាចឬល្ពៅ

steps.text_kh: ត្រីធ្វើឱ្យស្អាតកាប់ជាកង់ៗ ស្លឹកគ្រៃហាន់ឱ្យល្អិត ដាក់ខ្ជាយ រមៀត ខ្ទឹមសបុកឱ្យម៉ដ្ឋ
steps.text_en: Clean the fish and cut into rings; finely chop lemongrass and pound with fingerroot, turmeric, and garlic.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer samlor dish Samlor Proheur (Sour Fish Soup), step 1: Clean the fish and cut into rings; finely chop lemongrass and pound with fingerroot, turmeric, and garlic.

steps.text_kh: ត្រឡាចចិតស្តើងល្មម ល្ពៅចិតកាស់ដុំៗ ស្លឹកជីរ ស្លឹកម្ទេស បេះលាងឱ្យស្អាតទុកសិន
steps.text_en: Peel lime or lemon into thin strips; wash basil and chili leaves; set aside.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer samlor dish Samlor Proheur (Sour Fish Soup), step 2: Peel lime or lemon into thin strips; wash basil and chili leaves; set aside.

steps.text_kh: ទើបដាំទឹកឱ្យពុះ ជ្រុំប្រហុកបង់អំបិលបន្តិច រួចដាក់ត្រីបង់ចូលឱ្យឆ្អិន
steps.text_en: Bring water to a boil; add prahok and a little salt; add the fish and cook through.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer samlor dish Samlor Proheur (Sour Fish Soup), step 3: Bring water to a boil; add prahok and a little salt; add the fish and cook through.

steps.text_kh: ដួសខ្លះបេះយកតែសាច់បុកជាមួយគ្រឿង ទើបបង់ល្ពៅ ឬត្រឡាចចូលឱ្យឆ្អិន ចាក់ទឹកត្រី ស្ករ ម្សៅស៊ុប សឹមដាក់គ្រឿងដាំឱ្យពុះ ភ្លក់មើលឱ្យល្មម មុនដាក់ចុះ សឹមបង់ស្លឹកជីរចូល
steps.text_en: Scoop some fish, pound the flesh with the spices, return with lemon or lime; season with fish sauce, sugar, and soup powder; simmer; add basil leaves just before serving.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer samlor dish Samlor Proheur (Sour Fish Soup), step 4: Scoop some fish, pound the flesh with the spices, return with lemon or lime; season with fish sauce, sugar, and soup powder; simmer; add basil leaves just before serving.
